{{Quote|Can't you smell it on the air? Beneath everything else, the scent of ringwood petals. They must pump it into the air to overcome the stench. It's a flowering shrub from Kalimahr. Beautiful.|[[Tre Sana]], to [[Lanoree Brock]]|<ref name="Into the Void" />}}
'''Ringwood petals''' were a type of a [[Flower/Legends|flowering]] [[Bush/Legends|shrub]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]].<ref name="Into the Void" />

{{Flora-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ringwood petals first appeared in ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'', a [[2013]] novel written by [[Tim Lebbon]].<ref name="Into the Void" />

*''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'' {{Ab|Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void (audiobook)}} {{1st}} {{C|scent only}}
